episodes.synopsis: Hina Tsurugi is starting high school in the countryside. She’s excited to join the Handicrafts Club, but she runs into a girl named Yuki by the ocean and before she knew it, she somehow joined something called the Breakwater Club.
episodes.title: Breakwater Club

episodes.synopsis: Hina and Natsumi head to the Breakwater Club where Yuki has them participate in a club "tradition." Later on, Hina tries to learn the basics of fishing.
episodes.title: Reels and Casting

episodes.synopsis: The girls in the Breakwater Club head over the Kamegahama to try to fish for some flatheads.
episodes.title: Flatheads

episodes.synopsis: The girls head to a fishing shop to help Hina find a fishing jacket. Later on, they try to catch some squid by using a fishing jig called "Egi."
episodes.title: Eging

episodes.synopsis: The girls go clamming and Hina and Natsumi meet the Breakwater Club’s advisor for the first time.
episodes.title: Clamming and an Advisor

episodes.synopsis: Ms. Kotani stops by again and asks the girls to fish for some li’l horsies so they can have some for dinner. Later on, Hina’s mom finds some old fishing gear and Hina attempts to go fishing all alone.
episodes.title: Li'l Horsies

episodes.synopsis: Hina attempts light rock fishing for the first time with the other girls. Later on, Hina goes to Natsumi’s house to study for midterms.
episodes.title: Light Rock Fishing

episodes.synopsis: Hina and the rest of the Breakwater Club go to the river to fish for some freshwater prawns.
episodes.title: Freshwater Prawns

episodes.synopsis: The girls in the Breakwater Club learn how to float properly just in case they ever fall into the ocean. Later on, Hina goes to battle with a heron, but then notices it has a fishing line tangled around its leg.
episodes.title: Preparations and Herons

episodes.synopsis: Hina asks for something new and exciting, so they go fishing for some horsies again, but this time, use bobbers and fishing poles with no reels.
episodes.title: No-Reel Fishing

episodes.synopsis: Hina suddenly becomes assertive and tells the Breakwater Club that she wants to fish for whiting, so they go to Takohigeya to get the proper supplies. But to Hina’s dismay, fishing for whiting usually requires real worms.
episodes.title: Whiting

episodes.synopsis: Hina is determined to catch some whiting after doing some research online on how to catch them. Later on, Hina teaches Natsumi how to make some felt plushies.
episodes.title: From Now On...
